# What are your startup stock options actually worth?

> Free startup stock option calculator. See what an offer's options are really worth after dilution, liquidation preferences, vesting cliff, exercise cost and tax, weighted by the exit odds you choose. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
